metadata.judge_brief: Cashfree order: posts order_amount, INR, customer_details (id/email), returns the payment_session_id.
CheckoutButton: useTransition wraps a fetch to checkout server action / route, redirects to returned url via window.location.
Dodo Payments checkout: POSTs to api.dodopayments.com with product/customer, Bearer key, returns payment_link.
LemonSqueezy checkout: POST to /v1/checkouts with variantId, custom data containing userId, Authorization Bearer header, returns checkout url.
LemonSqueezy webhook: verify HMAC sha256 with webhook secret, parse event JSON, handle event_name (order_created/subscription_*).
Paddle checkout: POSTs to api.paddle.com with priceId + customer, Authorization Bearer, returns transaction url.
createRazorpayOrder: razorpay.orders.create with amount, currency, returns order.
ensureStripeCustomer: stripe.customers.create({ email, metadata: { userId } }), persists stripeCustomerId on user.
Stripe one-time payment: mode='payment', line_items with price/quantity, success/cancel URLs, returns session.url.
